description: In OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html), connect to the 'demodb' database (username: root, password: GymAnything123!). Navigate to the Schema tab and click on the 'Hotels' class. Create a new index on the 'Name' property of the Hotels class. The index should be of type NOTUNIQUE (since multiple hotels could share a name). Name the index 'Hotels.Name'. This index will speed up hotel lookups by name in the travel agency application.
